positions.title: ATG Software Engineer
positions.description:
Continuous integration infrastructure using terraform, Buildkite, and AWS . 
Writing developer tools and automated testing using bash and python in a Bazel environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed internal tool for Support team from initial mockups to launch to increase team  productivity.
Created React-based frontend, Flask-based backend, and testing framework for the tool.
Conducted user research to help Support team improve the Lyft Help experience.
Collaborated with other teams to collect micro-service requirements and defined MVP scope.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Shipped the server-side of the image-generating pipeline for Google AdWords.
Designed and implemented a prototype based on latency constraints, database constraints, and modularity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented a blockchain model with HyperLedger Fabric along with a REST Server for business transactions. 
Developed a service API with Spring.io and a blockchain API with Node.JS and Express.
Wrote blockchain smart contracts using Go-based chaincode.
